notes.title: Bionite: Origins Full Release Sale 2022
notes.notes:
[b]Were having our first sale in Full Release! [/b]

The game finally made it to Final Release and we want everyone who has followed its development over the years a chance to play it.  

For those who have been following the games development - there is a full BZ-style strategy game with 3 maps to play head to head games. Up to 8 players on each team can play as pilot with wingman (bot) commands!

notes.title: Major Game Bug Fixes and New Content
notes.notes:
After getting some really great feedback from the community we made some changes to the singleplayer missions. We needed to make it easier for players to locate the mission goals, so we added a couple of new HUD indicators:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11281819/7cca6f8fe052bf5c8fdeb69fce584be5fd505697.png[/img]
Then we went through each mission, goal by goal, and made it easier to complete. Its our first attempt at single player missions and until we got some feedback we had no idea if the missions were too difficult.  The tool tip and mission goal text was also revised to make it easier to understand exactly what the goal is. 

During our mission revision we also fixed alot of bugs. There were issues with the collisions that needed to be fixed. (no more vehicle clipping the static meshs!) We also tuned alot of algorithms to make the vehicles drive smoother and adjust their pitch depending on the slope. 

The full version also includes 3 maps for team death match (TDM). Check out the 3rd map in the TDM rotation ("Universe Map 1"), its a preview of whats to come.  Here is a screen shot of the map in development:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11281819/5ef8767620477b16761121a42e5d94f9c3adc448.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 03 - Bug Fixes and Minor Mission Changes
notes.notes: We fixed the broken Key Mapping System. Special thanks to the community for helping find this bug. All changes to the key map will now work and be saved. We are working on adding controller support, should be in an upcoming patch. Also we are working on making the missions easier to play. In this patch we changed how the mission starts by reducing the number of enemy bots and recommending using the Bayonet Shield to get out of the hangar. We really appreciate all the feedback and bug reports we get from the gaming community. Since we are just 2 devs working on the game, its really hard to find all the bugs, Thanks! -LtF

notes.title: Major Change to Missions and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11281819/b6c6692f55947090eebc5891b4bbf4ebafa93485.png[/img]

In this revision, we fixed alot of bugs and replaced the beginning to mission 1.

The invert mouse bug has been resolved and the aim/steer sensitivity has be increased. 

The beginning of mission 1: Emze Mine has be modified significantly. When starting the mission, the player now just has to get into the Bayonet and drive to the geyser. We took out the trip in the Hopper because it was taking too long. In this revision the player starts mission 1 in the Hangar Shed and only has to get into the Bayonet before issuing an order to the wingmen to follow. Once that is complete, just drive over to the geyser and deploy it. 

We fixed several more bugs and added a new key for rotating the players view in the vehicles. Once in the vehicle, use the Shift + Mouse to change the aiming yaw and the Control + Mouse for the view look. Using the SHFT + Mouse when firing the weapon allows the player to better aim due to the lateral movement of the gun barrels. The Control + Mouse is used for looking around from inside the vehicle without changing the weapons aim.

We also added a Tool Tip summary for quick reference. It can be accessed from the singleplayer missions using the menu to select the mission. This can be useful for looking up how to use specific features of the game like issuing orders to wingmen and building assets.

notes.title: New Content for the Single Player Missions Demo
notes.notes:
We just published revision 2 for the single player missions Demo. The Full Version will be updated with these two new missions and one more multiplayer map at the end of next week.  This update includes two new missions with trainers, one on Europa and the other on Venus. The mission on Europa involves finding the Spectralite after rescuing the hostage bot from the enemy.  The second mission on Venus involves protecting the convoy of loaders from attack and defending the Main Pump.
We are getting some feedback that some are having issues starting the missions, it is confusing. In order to start the missions, Hit the Z key first. The z key pulls up the Mission Goals and gives a brief summary of the mission.  Once you close the missions goals the mission will start. Close the Mission Goals by hitting the Z key again. Then after the mission starts, when the goals change you can use the Z key to toggle the missions update screen open and closed. This is the same for the tool tips, but use the SHFT + Z key to toggle that screen open and closed. 
We are currently working on adding another map to the multiplayer version of the game. Once that is finished in a few days, we will update the full version with the new single player maps also. Also, we are currently working on adding the [i]sniper rifle[/i]  and the Spectralite weapons/shields modifier to the multiplayer games.
We did fix many bugs in this revision however none of them were game killers, just minor tweeks to make the missions more engaging and easier to follow. Thanks! ~ LtFEED

notes.title: Critical Viewing: Commander Tutorial 1, Deploy a Pump
notes.notes:
[b]Tutorial Number 1 of Many. [/b] Were going to start with the basics in this tutorial: How to Build and Deploy a Pump.  The Pump is a deployed Collector. Its job is to suck bioore out of geysers and send it back to the refinery.  At the refinery the bioore is processed into usable Bionite. Bionite is the main resource in the game. WIthout it Commanders can not build and well, that pretty much it.  In this tutorial I go over how to deploy the Refabricator, build a Collector, then deploy it over a geyser into a Pump. I include all the key strokes in the text so you guys can see exactly which keys are being used for the Command Menu. Let me know if you have any questions or comments. thanks ~LtF

notes.title: The Bionite: Origins Demo has released on Steam!
notes.notes:
The Bionite: Origins Demo has released on Steam. It includes the first 2 single players missions only. Multiplayer is still only available in the full version. Set on the planets of Venus and Mars, the demo missions include trainers for learning the command system (used in the multiplayer version). They also introduce the backstory about what Bionite and Spectralite are and how to use them in the game. You can drive the Bayonet Light Tank and engage the enemy to test out the unique vehicle hover propulsion system. The Bayonet sorta drives like a military jet hovering about 3 feet off the ground. Anyone on the fence about the game? The demo is a great way to check out how much progress we have made since the last release!

notes.title: MAJOR DEVELOPMENT UPDATE - Multiplayer and SinglePlayer Released!
notes.notes:
After 10 years of work..........
We finally got the full version of strategy FPS/RTS posted for the public!!!
We had no idea that it would take this long to complete.  Making games using the Unreal engine is almost impossible, and this game is 100x more complex than most.  There is so much in the game it would be impossible to explain here. This release is the first Beta of Bionite. It has all but just a few of the  features that will be available in the final release.  The full command system is ready for you guys to check out. For example: the tanks have the following commands: Follow, Hold, Go To Location, Go To Navigation Beacon, Attack, Hunt, Patrol, Fly in Formation, Protect, and Reassign to a new player or squad.
The single player missions introduce the alien race and contain tool tips to help people learn the complex command system. The missions explain what Bioore and Spectralite are and how to use them. We are going to keep the game in early access for a few more weeks while we finish the new trailer. Once the trailer is done, were going to release an update then move the game to Final Release. Hotshot and I super appreciate all the support from our community and the extreme patients that you guys have had. I wish we could have done this faster, but making a [i]stable[/i] game of this complexity is EXTREMELY difficult to do. More announcements to come shortly......~LtF

notes.title: Were Finally Getting Ready to Release an Update
notes.notes:
Sorry about the delay updating the game, but we had alot of work to do and even more testing.  By the end of this month we will have a major overhaul posted with more bug fixes than i can list and a new map.  We have spent hundreds of hours getting this new update done. Some of the improvements:

No more fixed camera, we moved it to a rotating one that is much smoother and easier to aim.

Better Vehicle handling and maneuvering using better physics.

Bug fixes for the AI that werent quit working as good as they should. The slow extractor for example, is fixed.

The new interior for the Bayonet, the Longbow, and Rhino.  

The new map for Mars is a trainer with tool tips but focuses more on engaging the enemy in battle.

New Patrol State for the wingmen.  Now you can set nav beacons around your base and tell your wingmen to Patrol using those beacons as waypoints.

The preliminary character mesh with the sniper rifle and the jetpack might be in this release. It might have to wait until the next one if I cant get it working right.

The Water Mine Mission on Europa will be done at the end of May and the Pit Mine Mission at the end of June. Once the first four singleplayer maps are done, were going to move to full release. 

Immediately after full release were going to start testing MP and continue to add maps and new content.  Thanks to everyone that has supported our mission of bringing this game to life, were working on hella more content and new maps right now.

notes.title: What is the game Bionite: Origins about?
notes.notes:
Bionite: Origins is a Real Time Strategy / First Person Shooter Hybrid game, also called an Action-Strategy Game. It consists of Real Time Strategy elements with first and third person views. Wingmen are commanded from a satellite, first, or third person views. Game matches occur on vast outdoor landscapes located on different planets, moons, and asteroids within the solar system. Bionite has two factions; Rebels and IMI. They are at war with each other for control of resources scattered throughout the solar system. The goal of each skirmish match is to destroy the enemy Refabricator before they destroy yours.
The game starts with the squadron captain located inside the team hangar with a Refabricator, two wingmen, and a limited supply of Bionite. All subsequent vehicles and buildings must be created by the Refabricator or Constructor.  These ‘genesis vehicles’ use digital printers to fabricate vehicles and buildings (assets) from a material called Bionite. Bionite is the refined form of Bioore, a unique mineral not found on earth. Bioore is composed of Dolomite and a type of mineral that contains a microscopic life form. When extracted from the Dolomite and charged with electricity, the life form contained in the rock can be ‘printed’ into various types of materials. A material that contains Bionite has very unique properties that are highly prized by the military: extreme hardness and the ability to self heal.  Once a vehicle hull containing Bionite has been printed it can be repaired simply by exposing it to electricity. On the battlefield a large force of Bionite-reinforced vehicles are very difficult to stop, and impossible to completely destroy. 
Gathering resources to produce Bionite is accomplished by harvesting Bioore using a scavenger or an extractor type vehicle.  Scavengers collect Bioore located on the planet surface. When over a Biopool the scavenger becomes an extractor. The extractor drills into Biopools to siphon out liquid Bioore in much larger quantities than a scavenger can collect from the surface.

notes.title: Update Posted 10/31/17
notes.notes:
We posted an updated today with several bug fixes, clarification on the tool tips, and the new Main Menu (with new music theme). We are currently overhauling the RTS system in preparation for Full Release. A preview of some of the new RTS features, such as the new Bunker model, are in this update.  We had some requests for clarification on the Tool Tips, which we did make.   The Hunter Mission to destroy the turret was confusing some people, so we made it clear that it had to be destroyed. 

The next update will include several new models, and a new map. The Biodome 24 Mission will be ready for release soon.  This map will be the last map we release for singleplayer before the full release on Steam.  During the time up until the full release, we will release hotfixes and patches at least once a month.  The custom key map system should be ready soon and will be part of a patch coming in November. 

The Full Release will have at least 4 singleplayer missions that can be played as either the IMI or Rebels.  Skirmish Mode will also be working for one vs one strat against the computer.   Multiplayer is currently in development and we plan on releasing it at the beginning of the 2nd quarter in 2018.

notes.title: All Distribution Problems have been Resolved
notes.notes: With help from Valve we were able to resolve all the problems we were having with the distribution system. The game is now fully playable through the steam client. The no executable problem and the reinstall problem we were having as a result of not have the game configured correctly are fixed. If anyone was having a problem launching the game or was frustrated by having to reinstall the game each time it was launched we apologize and have fixed the issues. Now you can hop into a Rhino or Bayonet, build a base, and defend it from the enemy whenever you want!

notes.title: Fix for Reinstall problems created when Launching from Steam Client
notes.notes: I just posted a new revision to Steam. This revision has the executable "BIONITE2C". This has a fix for the reinstall problem we have been having with Steam. EVERYONE Please get this new revision after uninstalling your old revision and clearing your appcache on Steam. The problem we had to fix had to do with the Unsetup.exe program that manages the EULA and updates the registry. UDK has no work around for this issue when published to Steam. Steam wants the unzipped files, not the install file. Until we fixed it, if the game was launched through Steam, the game would try to update the registry with Unsetup.exe. The problem was that Unsetup.exe only runs from the zipped install file when packaged using the FrontEnd program (this program creates the cooked version of the game and packs it for distribution). If the game was launched through Steam it would crash because the registry was not updated with the accepted EULA. In order to fix this, we had to create an application that would bypass the EPIC Unsetup and update the registry. Now that we have done that, all of the install problems with Steam should be resolved. Many people were getting really strange problems because of this...that had nothing to do with the game!

notes.title: Revision 1 is posted!

We made many enhancements and fixes based on the community input.
Here is the build notes for Revision 1:

Build Notes Revision 1
Bionite:Origins Steam Release

•	Added Team Colors. Enemy = red. Friendly = blue
•	Added Thump weapon on Kodiak using the U key. Charger indicator in      MFD works
•	Squad menu fixed to reflect existing vehs in squad.
•	Each vehicle type gets assigned to its own squad. Added the Left Shift key to select squad 8 to squad 14
•	Adjusted the cull distance to reduce model popping
•	Fixed the blowing dust rate to change density over time
•	Added the Trainer setting to the difficulty slider. Trainer setting stops enemy attacking to allow for base building and command practice
•	Fixed command menu access when vehicle is destroyed and pilot is auto-ejected
•	Fixed command control of the Lynx, Spyder turret, Diamond Back turret, and Repair Drone.  
•	Adjusted the building height from landscape when built (so buildings don’t hover)

•	Fixed the pilot view to stop adjusting when issuing commands. 
•	Enhanced the Muzzleflash particle systems for the Rhino and Lynx
•	Fixed the weapon pickup and weapon switching using the right mouse button. Pilots can now build guns using the Armory to add to the vehicle weapons array. Weapons switch after pickup from canister dispensed by Armory.
•	Reduced the bloom amount for the light beams
•	Fixed the pilot eject in the Rhino
•	Sat view only working when Sat Tower built
•	Fixed Factory build sequence to run when power is on
•	Adjusted the client messaging to appear above the MFD

Working on for Full Release:
•	Factory interior. Ability to build custom vehicles. Ability to create custom weapon loadouts for all vehicles.
•	Custom Attack patterns that can be created outside of runtime.
•	Expanding the Ranking system
•	Fixing the mouse sensitivity to stop resetting between each match..
•	Custom Squads for AI wingmen
•	Cannons, mortars, rockets weapons
•	Changing the ordering sequence for the constructor to select asset first then place. location beacon
•	Fly in Formation for all vehicles
•	Character model
•	Sniper Rifle
•	APC vehicle
•	Howitzer
•	One more tank vehicle for a total of 8
•	Scripted missions
•	Two more maps, The Water Mine on Europa and a new Venus map set    on the volcanic side of the planet.
•	Mutliplayer Strat with team commanders and up to 15 pilots per team. Ability to assign AI vehicles to pilots.
•	Coop Skirmish
•	Mine selection using the Armory

•	Fixed the weapon pickup and weapon switching using the right mouse button. Pilots can now build guns using the Armory to add to the vehicle weapons array. Weapons switch after pickup from canister dispensed by Armory.

notes.title: Bionite: Origins is now on Steam Early Access
notes.notes: The premier Action-Strategy game has been released on Steam Early Access.  After 6 years in development, Bionite is an engaging, strategy driven game that integrates RTS and FPS into a seamless gaming experience.  Our Skirmish Mode for Singleplayer pits you against the computer for control of three worlds: Venus, Mars, and the Moon. This game is defiantly not for typical 'run and gun' players because it requires base building and strategy to win. With an extensive tech tree for base building, we strongly recommend reading the game manual before playing the game.  During our time on Early Access we will be developing the turn based missions, Multiplayer, and expanding the features and content.  We strongly recommend players get accustomed to the command system and building structure before the Multiplayer release. We are also asking for input from the community to help make the game better, easier to understand and learn, and reducing multiplayer griefing in order to maximize the fun.
